results.title: Bloom
results.overview: When Lily inherits her great aunt's struggling desert nursery, she devotes herself to bringing it back to life. As her garden flourishes, her need to sustain it becomes something she can no longer control.

results.title: Accidental Truth: Next - Beyond UFO Disclosure
results.original_title: Accidental Truth: Next - Beyond UFO Disclosure
results.overview: An amazing cast takes you on a journey beyond UFO Disclosure. It starts within the cement walls of Washington DC, and then guides you beyond your imagination. Prepare for an awesome adventure that will leave you questioning EVERYTHING.

results.title: You, Fireworks, and Our Promise
results.overview: The coming-of-age romance is set during the Nagaoka Festival Grand Fireworks Show, one of Japan's three major fireworks shows that draws several hundred thousand visitors to Niigata Prefecture every year. What connects Makoto (a Tokyo high school boy without social skills or self-confidence) and Aki (a popular high school girl and class president with beauty and talent) is a drawing of a fireworks display. At the mercy of the drawing's mystery and fate itself, the two have to make a choice in a limited amount of time.

results.title: Ney Behind the Masks
results.overview: Follows Ney Matogrosso as he prepares for the parade of Imperatriz Leopoldinense, transforming Carnival into a space for exploring identity, freedom, and mortality. Amid rehearsals and significant encounters, the film reveals an intimate side of Ney as he revisits the choices that have shaped his journey, prompting reflection on the masks we wear throughout our lives and the courage it takes to remain true to who we are.

results.title: Under the Same Sun
results.overview: 1819. A young Spanish heir, a Chinese weaver, and a Haitian deserter struggle to find their place and humanity in the tense cultural crossroads of the colonial Caribbean. They embark on the ambitious endeavor of establishing a silk factory in the very heart of the island of Hispaniola.

results.title: Unraveled
results.overview: Maria is a former elite swimmer and famous sports commentator whose life unravels when her beloved husband Mikael, her former coach and father of their daughter, is suddenly suspected of sexual abuse. Sparking the scandal and media interest is the revelation in an upcoming book, of a young girl’s misguided infatuation for her swimming coach, with rumors suggesting that Mikael is the man in question.

results.title: Werewolf: Blood Inheritance
results.overview: Four archeology post-grads unearth and become victim to an ancient curse whilst digging up a strange set of ruins.

results.title: LipLock
results.overview: Liplock explores modern relationships, misunderstandings, and second chances.

results.title: Stardom in Osaka 2026 Feb.
results.overview: Stardom in Osaka 2026 Feb. was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on February 20, 2026 at EDION Arena Osaka No.2 in Osaka, Japan.

results.title: Djamin Setia Selamanya
results.overview: Educated under colonial rule, a determined young man from Tanah Karo enlists in a paramilitary unit under the false promise of liberation, ultimately rising to become a pivotal military strategist in North Sumatra's guerrilla defense while balancing acute domestic sacrifices with absolute duty to the nascent Indonesian Republic.

results.title: Second Chances
results.overview: A burnt-out manager returns to his childhood summer camp for a few days to temporarily take over from his ailing father. Instead of peace and quiet, however, he finds a crumbling facility, a wacky camp crew, and the return of his first love—who turns his life upside down.

results.title: The Last Spring
results.overview: Marion and Camille, 15, are inseparable. They arrive on a southern island for their final school trip, full of excitement and expectation. It’s a time of firsts, and the abrupt end of carefree days.

results.title: Evil Follows
results.overview: A husband's fight to save his wife from a demonic possession that began the moment the dybbuk box chose her as its next host.

results.original_title: Los ojos del futuro (La inmigracion Africana)

results.title: THE ORIGIN OF ULTRAMAN
results.overview: The landmark Japanese Tokusatsu TV series Ultraman became a massive social phenomenon upon its debut in 1966, reaching a staggering peak viewership rating of 42.8%. Six decades later, Tsuburaya Productions continues to introduce new entries into the Ultraman series, expanding its unique universe to a global audience across generations. This documentary brings together leading voices from the fields of cinema, Tokusatsu, and design. Witness profound testimonies from an international assembly of creators, including: Guillermo del Toro, Hirokazu Kore-eda, Hideo Kojima, Hideaki Anno, Shinji Higuchi, and Nicolas Winding Refn.

results.title: Powerwolf - Wildlive (Live at Olympiahalle)
results.overview: Powerwolf are back - louder, more epic and more impressive than ever before!  Recorded at the breathtaking final concert of the Wolfsnächte Tour 2024 in Munich's sold-out Olympiahalle, WILDLIVE is far more than just another live recording - it's a grandiose, cinematic experience full of fire, emotion and boundless creativity.

results.title: CMLL: The Night of The Amazonas 2026
results.original_title: CMLL: The Night of The Amazonas 2026
results.overview: In celebration of International Women's Day, CMLL presents The Night of The Amazonas 2026, a historic all-women wrestling spectacular streaming live on TrillerTV from Arena México.  This star-studded event brings together elite talent from CMLL, AEW, Stardom, and the lucha libre indies for one unforgettable night of high-impact action, championship gold, and international rivalries.  The main event features global superstar Mercedes Moné defending the CMLL Women's World Championship against rising CMLL standout Persephone.

results.title: The Executor
results.overview: A reclusive heiress, bound by blood and burden, invites seven distant relatives to her decaying manor with whispers of inheritance. Beneath the promise lies a quiet cruelty- a gauntlet of secrets, temptation, and ruin. As family bonds unravel, she watches, choosing not just a successor, but a soul willing to bear the curse she can no longer carry. One will inherit the family estate, but only the heiress knows the hefty price they'll pay.
